up: Find compounds that have at least one activity record in a Cytochrome P450 2C9 assay performed on human (tax_id = 9606) and return their ChEMBL identifiers (pref_name) together with the canonical SMILES. The result set must be deduplicated so that each molecule appears only once.
sql:
WITH human_cyp2c9_assays AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_chembl_id
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
  WHERE td.pref_name LIKE '%Cytochrome P450 2C9%'
    AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND ass.assay_tax_id = 9606
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  GROUP BY a.molecule_chembl_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.activity_id) >= 1
), human_cyp2c9_mols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM human_cyp2c9_assays hca
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON hca.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
)
SELECT DISTINCT pref_name AS molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles AS SMILES
FROM human_cyp2c9_mols;

up: Retrieve the ChEMBL identifier (CHEMBL ID) and the canonical SMILES for every molecule that has at least one activity measurement in a Cytochrome P450 2C9 assay performed on human (tax_id = 9606). The output should list each qualifying compound only once (deduplicate by ChEMBL ID) and include exactly two columns: molecule_chembl_id and SMILES.
sql:
WITH human_cyp2c9_assays AS (
  SELECT a.molregno
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.pref_name LIKE '%Cytochrome P450 2C9%'
    AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND ass.assay_tax_id = 9606
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.molregno
), molecule_with_smile AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM human_cyp2c9_assays hca
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON hca.molregno = md.molregno
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
)
SELECT DISTINCT molecule_chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles AS SMILES
FROM molecule_with_smile;
